Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 有一个老男人叫神农：老人，“老男人“ has negative meaning
- 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服：delete “在古代”, it implies that 神农can travel between 古代 and 现代modern times; 都看到，no了for routine/habit; 别的小镇上的人；生病或者不舒服
- 他下一天开始爬当地的山脉：第二天，当地的大山，山脉is for geography

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老男人：老人，this is the usual respectful and natural noun for an elderly male character; the original word can sound informal or negative in a story. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的：删除，this word distinguishes other people or things from a specifically mentioned one, but no such comparison has been established here. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 小镇人：小镇上的人们，this refers to a concrete group in the town, so it needs a location phrase and the group noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 还是：或，an affirmative statement listing two possible conditions uses this connector, while the original connector is normally used in questions or alternatives under discussion. [rule: none]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 找了各种各样的植物：找到了各种各样的植物，this action means that the plants were found; the corrected verb expresses a successful result. [vocab list]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农在古代：他在古代，after the name was used in the immediately previous sentence and no other male character has appeared, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农试一试：他试一试，use a pronoun because the same character was mentioned in the preceding sentence and there is no competing referent. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每一天看到了：每一天看到，an action that happens every day is a routine, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 所以：因为……所以，these two events have a cause-and-effect relationship, so introduce the cause with 因为 and link it to the result with 所以. [rule: none]

items.reason: “老男人” can sound derogatory for this character, while “老人” is the appropriate noun.
The teacher retained “别的” in “别的小镇上的人,” so deleting it is not warranted.
A concrete group should be “小镇上的人们,” not the ungrammatical location-noun combination “小镇人.”
In this affirmative statement, “或者/或” is required rather than “还是.”
“找了各种各样的植物” is acceptable and does not require the result complement “到.”
The close re-reference should use “他,” but the displayed correction wrongly leaves “在古代,” which the teacher required deleting.
Since 神农 was just mentioned and no competing male referent exists, “他” is required by the reference rule.
“每一天” describes a routine, so “看到” should not take completed-action 了.
“所以” already links the stated cause and result adequately, and “因为……所以” is only an incomplete template rather than a usable correction.
